purpose: Separate objective inadequacy from QUBO discretization error by comparing the continuous exponential best-rank set objective with deterministic 4, 8, 16, and 32-level auxiliary-variable QUBO approximations.

development.continuous_objective: For each seed and ligand, take max_i exp(-20*r_sli) over selected receptors; subtract the decoy class mean from the active class mean and average the three seed discriminations.
development.rankbin_rule: q_B(r)=floor(B*exp(-20*r))/B=(1/B)*sum_{b=1}^B I(exp(-20*r)>=b/B), converting each cumulative utility level into an OR auxiliary variable.
development.resolution_policy: Bin count is the only model axis. Biological weights, class weights, seed weights, fold assignments, and search settings are identical across all resolutions.

qubo_encoding.representation: Exact factorized quadratic constraints plus compact hexadecimal receptor-incidence masks; sparse coefficient expansion is deferred because it does not alter the QUBO energy.

interpretation_boundary: Stage67 is post-hoc objective-fidelity adjudication on four consumed historical targets. The continuous reference is not a hardware model, and the rank-bin QUBO is assessed only as an approximation to that reference. A pass may freeze B=32 only for preregistration on a genuinely new target. This stage cannot establish independent efficacy, solver advantage, quantum execution, speedup, or quantum advantage.
